page_title: BOL 2-0 NAP | Bologna v Napoli 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' A pass by Juan Miranda (Bologna) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+1' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to intercept.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
89' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) meets a cross inside the box, but Massimo Pessina wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
87' Fouls committed – 12:15.
84' The referee blows his whistle as Noa Lang (Napoli) was too aggressive in his challenge.
83' Napoli keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
82' Antonio Conte decides to make a substitution. Scott McTominay will be replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli).
81' Substitution. Tommaso Pobega did his best and is replaced by Nikola Moro (Bologna).
81' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Nicolo Casale (Bologna) replaces Riccardo Orsolini.
79' The foul by Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) was seen by Daniele Chiffi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
79' The current number of corner kicks is 4:4.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juan Jesus (Napoli) comes onto the pitch so that Alessandro Buongiorno can be given a rest.
77' Here is a change. Miguel Gutierrez is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Mathias Olivera (Napoli).
76' David Neres (Napoli) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Chiffi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Napoli fail to score from a corner as Massimo Pessina (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) was quite harsh and Daniele Chiffi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
72' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
70' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Noa Lang (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
69' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:3.
68' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Eljif Elmas is replaced by Noa Lang (Napoli).
67' That's the end of the game for Matteo Politano, who is replaced by David Neres (Napoli).
66' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) does well to meet a cross inside the box and plants a header into the top right corner.
63' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
62' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
61' Jens Odgaard will be replaced by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna).
60' Napoli are seeing far more of the ball now.
58' Bologna take a short corner kick.
58' Matteo Politano (Napoli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
56' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle as Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

56' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
54' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
53' An attempted cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared.
52' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna).
50' 1 - 0 Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
48' Massimo Pessina displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) comes off for Nicolo Cambiaghi.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+4' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Napoli get a corner.
45+3' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
42' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
41' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) trips an opposition player and Daniele Chiffi signals a foul.
40' Corner kicks – 4:1.
38' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' A spell of possession for Napoli in an attempt to control the game.
35' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
33' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic was alert and made a comfortable save.
30' Juan Miranda (Bologna) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
28' Bologna hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
26' 2:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
24' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' What a miss! The corner finds Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
22' Corner kick. Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is ready to send the ball into the box.
20' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
20' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bologna.
20' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Massimo Pessina makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
16' Napoli keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
14' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
12' 45:55 – the latest ball possession ratio.
10' Bologna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
8' Vincenzo Italiano is forced to make a change. Lukasz Skorupski is unable to continue due to injury, Massimo Pessina (Bologna) comes on.
5' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
3' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi will referee today's match.
